plan.sheet_prompt:
Illustration sheet: a 3x3 arrangement of 9 separate characters, one per equal cell of an invisible grid, with wide empty gaps between them.
Subject: angel with white wings and halo, holding a newspaper in every cell.
Style: flat vector illustration, bold clean shapes, solid vibrant colours, friendly proportions.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Each cell shows a clearly different, highly expressive emotion and pose, row-major:
1. smiling while reading
2. surprised by news
3. nodding in agreement
4. raising eyebrow
5. laughing at article
6. frowning at headline
7. thinking deeply
8. turning page
9. putting down newspaper
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows, mouth and body language.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours in all 9 cells.
Background: one single flat pure green (#00FF00) colour over the entire image, the identical exact shade in every cell and in the gaps between the characters; no visible cell, panel or grid lines, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Margin: every character is full body, centred in its cell, with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its cell), nothing touching or crossing a cell edge.
plan.video_prompt:
Animate this illustration sheet as a 3-second seamless loop. Every character performs its own big, expressive, cartoon-style animation in place, inside its own cell:
1. smiling while reading, with big lively expressive movement in place
2. surprised by news, with big lively expressive movement in place
3. nodding in agreement, with big lively expressive movement in place
4. raising eyebrow, with big lively expressive movement in place
5. laughing at article, with big lively expressive movement in place
6. frowning at headline, with big lively expressive movement in place
7. thinking deeply, with big lively expressive movement in place
8. turning page, with big lively expressive movement in place
9. putting down newspaper, with big lively expressive movement in place
Animation style: exaggerated squash and stretch, anticipation and follow-through, clear facial animation (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), secondary motion on ears, tails and props, each character on its own rhythm, lively and full of personality. Never a static pose and never only a gentle sway.
Keep every character inside its own slot of the 3x3 layout; nothing may touch or cross a slot edge, and characters never interact with one another.
Empty slots stay empty: do not add any character, object or effect to them.
Static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Keep the one flat pure green (#00FF00) background exactly as it is, the same shade everywhere: no shadows, no gradient, no noise, no glow.
Keep each character's design, proportions and colours unchanged and do not add outlines or borders.
End on the starting pose so the clip loops.
